subject: mineral terraces and quiet pools
art_direction: 浅色矿物阶台托起几层温柔蓝绿水面，极细蒸汽融入远山薄雾。
visible_description: 浅色矿物阶台托起几层温柔蓝绿水面，极细蒸汽融入远山薄雾。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Show pale mineral terraces holding three shallow blue-green pools, their irregular ledges stepping down through the lower two thirds of the frame. A faint thread of steam may merge into distant morning mist, never filling the scene. Use natural cream deposits, soft water reflections, and a low muted ridge beyond. Keep the upper fifth a smooth misty sky, with no people, boardwalks, signage, or dramatic geothermal activity. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper. Keep the upper 20% naturally quiet for the clock, with no lettering, logos, or watermark.
